$comment: Bundle budget for the static export, checked by scripts/perf-budget.mjs (QRun-IO/qqq#710). Sizes are KB gzip. '_' is the exported placeholder of a dynamic segment. The complete 1.0 UI includes wave-2 shell, record, form, process and widget parity. After lazy screen dispatch, the 2026-09-26 export measures 245.1 KB on login, 340.8 KB on the largest developer route, 371.7 KB on copy, and 1020.9 KB across all 97 emitted chunks (excluding separately budgeted RapiDoc). These caps leave roughly 3-5% headroom; route caps measure HTML first load and total measures all on-demand features. CI's default-builder export measured 19.2 KB gzip of shared CSS on 2026-09-26; the 21 KB cap leaves about 9% headroom. The 100 KB largest-chunk cap remains unchanged. Raise a cap only with a measured reason in the commit.

rapidoc.$comment: RapiDoc (the table developer view's API docs, QRun-IO/qqq#714) loads only when that view opens: import('rapidoc') in TableApiDocs. Measured 204.5 KB gzip at 1.0; budget about 5% above.
